title: Producer/Composer ‘Tricky’ Stewart Signs New Publishing Deal With BMG
summary: Known for his work with Beyoncé and Rihanna, Stewart was inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame earlier this year.
contentText:
Grammy-winning songwriter/producer Christopher “Tricky” Stewart has signed a global publishing administration agreement with BMG.

Stewart, who was inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame in June, has a body of work across the pop/R&B and hip-hop spectrum that includes Rihanna ’s Diamond-certified “Umbrella,” Beyoncé ’s 11x Platinum-certified “Single Ladies (Put a Ring on It),” Justin Bieber ’s 12x Platinum-certified “Baby,” Mariah Carey ’s 3x Platinum-certified “Touch My Body,” and Tyla ’s 3x Platinum-certified global breakout “Water.”  He has landed six No. 1s on Billboard’s Hot 100 .

Among the other artists he has written and/or produced include Mary J. Blige, Ciara, Britney Spears, Katy Perry, Celine Dion, Whitney Houston , Michael Jackson, Madonna , Alicia Keys, and BTS. He has also discovered and developed talent, including The-Dream, Frank Ocean and Ester Dean.

“In today’s music landscape, where the value of music and its creators is too often diminished, it was important for me to partner with a company like BMG,” Stewart said in a statement. “Seeing the incredible songwriters, producers, and artists on their roster reaffirmed that this was the right home. Working alongside [BMG’s] Tab Nkhereanye and Monti Olson has always been a winning formula for me, and having my longtime creative partner and genius, The-Dream, under the same roof makes this chapter even more special. I’m excited to begin this next run together and looking forward to everything we’ll accomplish.”

Olson, BMG executive vp/head of publishing, North America, added, “Tricky Stewart is one of the rare creators whose work is both timeless and constantly forward moving. His songs have defined cultural moments, launched careers, and shaped the sound of popular music at the highest level. We are honored to welcome him to BMG and support the next chapter of his extraordinary creative journey.”

Stewart, who is a past president of A&R at Epic Records, currently serves as chairman of the Recording Academy’s Atlanta chapter and co-chair of its Songwriters & Composers Wing. He is also co-owner of RZ3 Recordings. He was formerly with Spirit Music Group.
